excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<hwwang> > <hwwang>  replying to: 
 ```@hwwang wrote: 
 base_fee_per_gas is also uint256 in CL```
 I git-blamed it

In EIP, it was a field `excess_blobs: uint256`, and use this field to calculate the gas. But it was changed to use `excess_data_gas` directly in this PR (https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/5707). It seems the type of it has not been discussed.

Nice catch Péter 👍

excerpts.content: yeah, managed to make it work by checking if the first field data offset is equal to 100 (4 + 96 bytes fixed signature), In that case it is `SignedBeaconBlock`. Otherwise it should be `SignedBlockContents` and handled differently. Sounds a bit hacky, but covered it with tests. 😄
